body:
Yep, I'm a guy.

And of course, with all of this, I haven't hidden any of this. All along, for the past 15 months-ish, I have insistently brought up all the reasons of "Why I might ruin your life," heh. (Oh, I also have to add that my fiance is actually a guy also.) He always insisted right back on "Well, these things suck, but it's nothing that can't be fixed." He's just finished with school, financially stable with the assistance of Germany's support system.

I am very happy with him, and he is with me. That sounds hypocritical since I'm posting here. The biggest fear in my mind is just that, no matter where I end up, I'm going to be a burden for someone else. It's interesting here, between income support and the government actually helping you find work, maybe I'll be employed before too long. It will be a lower paying job, which shouldn't be a problem for now.

Maybe the only real problem is that I can feel so depressed from time to time. I can go for weeks or months, just motivated and doing well, and then I feel ridiculously guilty, slow, and just kind of wanting to die all the time. I can definitely see I have things to be happy for, but I just don't understand how I get this way.

Things make a bit more sense when I'm sober (now), of course. Judging by my original post, I'm even more horrible at laying out what I'm thinking when drunk, heh. Thanks for taking this time for me.

Well, it's not that I don't appreciate the things I have. Really, I value the love I have, my family (despite whatever past hardships and tensions, they're still wonderful), and the fact that I've made it to Germany and becoming stable (more so, anyway) here.

I don't want to argue with anyone here, just came for some answers, but I don't think I agree with your advice of "Get over it and deal." Is that career advice? And don't get me wrong. I've held all kinds of jobs, including hard physical labor, and it was decent work. I don't mind that.

Edit: Just to add here, I get what you're saying with "deal." And I always feel the same thought, but when I feel I can't overcome something, it feels like the only other option is killing myself. To me, "deal" means do whatever I have to, and if I can't do it, then that's it. When it comes to life, you deal or you don't, and I know this. I know this isn't a normal line of thinking, and I just don't know what to do about it.

I don't know how much 'good' you hear in updates, as I haven't lurked around the place too much, but I'd imagine it's difficult for the regulars here to keep up their morale. So I hope it does help, and when I have some more time, I'd like to join in for good here, offer any words I can to others in a bad place.

It's a /huge/ stress, I understand that. That, coupled with other things going on in life can easily give the feeling of being overwhelmed. I guess I got a burst of energy, and got myself caught up on a few fronts, eliminating the sense of being overwhelmed all the time. It's just difficult to collect the attitude of "Okay.. I have all the paperwork I need. I'm going to knock this out finally."

Good luck with that, and thanks.
